english.note: PTE Academic 58 also accepted. English proof applies when education was completed in countries where English is not an official language.

documents: Transcripts for all postsecondary education (unofficial for review; official after admission)
requirements.note: Bachelor’s degree in a similar field and GPA3.0; lower GPA may be considered with relevant experience/graduate study and program approval. Secure a major professor’s commitment to supervise research. Fall intake; spring only with special program permission.

funding.note: Beginning Fall2026, appointed PhD teaching assistants receive $23,368.80 for the nine-month academic year, in-state tuition coverage, nonresident tuition waiver and health insurance. Summer scholarship up to $8,000 depends on funding. This is an appointment package, not an all-admitted funding guarantee.

international.note: F-1/J-1 financial documentation required after admission.
